goal: Open Fixed Asset G/L Journals read-only and inventory only the non-executing Post related-actions/dropdown menu to find whether Preview Posting or depreciation-specific menu entries are present.

unlockedBy.decision: Only read-only dropdown/menu inventory is unlocked. No executing menu item may be clicked.

acceptanceCriteria: Business Central stays in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
Fixed Asset G/L Journals route is visible read-only.
Only the non-executing related-actions/dropdown button for Post is clicked.
Visible menu items are inventoried and classified.
If Preview Posting or Calculate Depreciation is found, only a later plan may decide the next action.
stopConditions: Business Central shows a different instance or company.
The locator points to the main Post button instead of the dropdown/related-actions button.
Any confirmation or modal dialog appears.
A menu item would need to be clicked to reveal the next level.
A journal line would need to be created or edited.
nextSafeAction: Run one read-only Post-dropdown menu inventory; do not click Calculate Depreciation, Preview Posting, Post or any menu item.
